name: train_1_start
title: Train it before a run: the training settings on the left

items.label: Model
items.text: Model: the learner to train (LightGBM (400 trees); Ridge; KNN (k=25); SVR (RBF, 8,000-sample subset)). LightGBM is the one the paper uses.

items.label: Target
items.text: Target: "physics + ML residual" learns only what the physics formula gets wrong; "pure ML (no physics)" learns battery power from scratch.

items.label: Amount of data
items.text: Amount of data: how many training samples to use, always whole trips, from a small part up to all of it. More data usually lowers the error, and takes longer.

items.label: Importance
items.text: Also compute the grouped permutation importance: which inputs the model leans on. It adds time, so untick it for a quick run.

items.label: Train on my device
items.text: Train on my device starts the training in your browser. It learns from the training trips and is scored on trips it never saw. The first time, scikit-learn and LightGBM are downloaded.

items.label: Status
items.text: The status chip shows Loading, Idle, Training or Done.

items.label: Keep the engine on this device
items.text: Optional: save the engine in your browser so the next visit starts without downloading. "Not now" saves nothing. Remove it any time on About.
